resources.string: Not available for this account right now
The saved settings could not be read. Until you save the settings again, all signals are blocked. Any change saves them.
Do not show that I am typing
Also hides recording voice and video messages and uploading files.
Do not mark messages as read
Chats stay unread for the other person. Opening and scrolling a chat do not send a read mark. The “%1$s” button asks first.
Voice and video messages are not marked as listened or viewed. One-time media asks before it opens.
Stories open without adding you to the viewers list and stay unread.
The app does not report that you are online. Telegram still shows you online for about 30 seconds when you send a message, read a private message or type.
Warn before actions that can show activity
Applies to sending messages and reactions.
Works only in this app and only for this account. Other devices and apps where you are signed in are not affected.
Sending a message, a reaction, a vote, a reply to a story or using a bot is visible to others.
Even with last seen hidden, Telegram may show you online for about 30 seconds after such actions.
Who can see when you were last seen
This is a Telegram rule for all your devices.
Set in the settings of each chat
The online status is the same in all chats and is not changed here.
The other person will see that the messages are read. Stealth mode does not apply to this action.
